title: Wemmbu Music Disc
description: This mod replaces the Mall music disc with Wemmbu's music (Playful Massacre from AZALI)!
body: This Mod replaces the Mall music disc with Wemmbu's music! (Plaful Massacre from AZALI) Wemmbu's music deserves to be in minecraft, so I replaced the boring mall music disc with Plaful Massacre from AZAlI. Some people also call it Wemmbu's theme song.
